hero.lede: An afternoon with Bloomberg CEO Vlad Kliatchko and senior leaders from across finance, policy and technology.

speakers.heading: Leaders deciding how AI is put to work across finance

about.heading: From experimentation to execution
about.body:
Join Bloomberg and our CEO, Vlad Kliatchko, at our flagship AI in Finance Summit, an exclusive gathering of senior financial leaders, policymakers, and technology luminaries.

As AI adoption accelerates across financial markets, the conversation is shifting from experimentation to execution, and to the decisions that will determine where AI creates lasting value and competitive differentiation.

Attendees will also have the opportunity to experience Bloomberg’s latest AI developments and see how they are being applied to help financial professionals work more efficiently and make more informed decisions.
about.listItems:
Where AI is delivering measurable value and creating investment edge
How it is reshaping research, investment workflows, and the role of financial professionals
How firms should approach governance and accountability as AI becomes more agentic

items.title: AI as institutional intelligence
items.body: Perspectives on where AI is headed and how it is being applied across the financial sector, evolving beyond a standalone tool into a connected intelligence engine that supports the entire investment cycle.

items.title: Responsible AI
items.body: Addressing bias, fairness, transparency, and the systemic risks AI introduces to financial stability, ensuring responsible governance frameworks that protect both institutions and end users.

items.title: Valuation & investment strategy
items.body: How senior peers are thinking about the productivity gains, revenue potential, and infrastructure costs that underpin investment decisions.
